scenarios.prompt: I'm running OMP and it says: New version 15.10.4 is available. Run: omp update. Before I install it, quickly check whether this update looks safe. I do not want a full audit of the whole product; I mainly need the diff from my current version and whether the binaries/install artifacts that omp update would install are consistent with the code/provenance.
scenarios.expected_failure_without_skill: Agent drifts into full repo audit, gives generic safety advice, skips updater mechanism, or fails to verify artifact provenance/binary-install path.

scenarios.prompt: Orca StablyAI on macOS popped an update prompt for version Xyz. I trust the app generally and want a quick pre-install check, not a giant audit. Check current app vs candidate, updater feed/procedure, artifact signing/notarization/team ID, and changed permissions/network endpoints before I click update.
scenarios.expected_failure_without_skill: Agent gives generic macOS app advice, omits Sparkle/appcast/update-feed checks, omits code signing/notarization details, or expands into a full app audit.

scenarios.prompt: A package manager says package foo can update from 2.3.1 to 2.3.2. It is already installed and trusted. I need a cheap safety gate: inspect changed lockfile/dependency/install-script surfaces and tell me SAFE/CAUTION/BLOCK before I run the upgrade. Don't audit the whole package if the updater path didn't change.
scenarios.expected_failure_without_skill: Agent either performs vulnerability-audit boilerplate only, misses changed install scripts/lockfiles, or lacks clear SAFE/CAUTION/BLOCK escalation rules.
